Komunikasi Data

Digital message exchange between air traffic control and aircraft, including CPDLC, ADS-C, and other datalink systems for clearances, instructions, and information (ICAO Doc 10037, GOLD).

Why it matters

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Komunikasi Data?

In this glossary, Komunikasi Data refers to: Digital message exchange between air traffic control and aircraft, including CPDLC, ADS-C, and other datalink systems for clearances, instructions, and information (ICAO Doc 10037, GOLD).

How is Komunikasi Data used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Komunikasi Data digunakan untuk izin ATC, pembaruan cuaca, dan perubahan rute, terutama di wilayah udara samudra dan terpencil."

Why does Komunikasi Data matter in aviation?

Komunikasi Data matters because it supports clear communication in Advanced ATC contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.
